items.excerpt: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available.

items.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
items.excerpt: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.

items.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
items.excerpt: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality.

items.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
items.excerpt: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export. Powered by Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow, Transformers apply those changes directly to log data before it reaches the destination.
